800:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Good work with your training, $n. Please have a sports drink.」

800:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How did it go? Did you get any ideas for a new finishing move?」

800:t_10:7.en:
$n
「If it were that easy, I wouldn't be struggling.」

800:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How are you doing in the mock battles?」

800:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I fought $$カミーユ$$, $$スザク$$, $$シン$$, $$カレン$$, $$デュオ$$, $$カトル$$, $$竜馬$$, and $$クロウ$$ five times each...」

800:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've lost a lot more than you've won, though I did expect that.」

800:t_10:12.en:
$n
「$$セツコ$$ pointed it out: I'd been relying on the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s power without realizing it.」

800:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... In that case, I recommend fighting without using GAI Mode on your next sortie.」

800:t_10:14.en:
$n
「In a real battle...? It might be worth a try.」

800:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Speaking of things worth trying, this is, too! Let's give it our all again today...」

800:t_10:16.en:
$n
「Sorry. No matter how good your advice is, I can't bring myself to do that.」

800:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's get back in the spirit! Let's give it our all again today... Business, business!」
